raw_segments.text: Third Servingman. Why he is so made on here within as if he were sun and air to Mars.
Set at upper end a T.H. table. No question asked him by any of the Senators but they
stand bald before him. Our General himself makes a mistress of him, sanctifies himself
with his hand, and turns up the white O.T.H. eye to his discourse.
But the bottom of the news is, our General is cut-eye T.H. Middle and but one half of
what he was yesterday, for the other has half, by the entreaty and grant of the whole
table. He'll go, he says, and soul the porter of Rome gates by T.H. ears. He will mow all
down before him and leave his passage pulled.
